What's new in 2.37.1

A fix for typing — and dictating — into an agent in Dax Shepherd.

The keyboard stays in an agent

  • What you type lands in the pane you're looking at. Shepherd only ever set focus — on a click, on the arrow keys, on the window coming forward — and nothing put it back when it came loose. A window holding its own keyboard swallows everything typed at it, so keystrokes went nowhere with no sign why. A pane that has the keyboard now keeps it, and one that loses it gets it back before the next keystroke, not after.
  • Dictation can find an agent to talk to. Willow, Wispr Flow and macOS Dictation all ask for the focused element and check what it is before they insert. With the keyboard sitting on the window there was no text area to find, and they refused. There is one now, so a dictated line reaches the agent — even with Dax not the frontmost app.
  • It stays out of your way. Focus is left exactly where it is for a sheet, a card drawn over the herd, any text field, and a terminal that already has it. Closing a card or finishing a rename hands the keyboard straight back to the pane rather than waiting to be noticed.

Also in this release

  • On the home screen, See every shortcut now sits below the two tools rather than between them — it's the footnote to that list, not a third entry in it.
  • Signed, notarized, universal (Apple Silicon & Intel), macOS 14+.
